# Tests

## Private fakes

There is no mocking library. Hand-write file-private fakes prefixed `_Silent`, `_Testable`, `_Recording`, `_Fake` or `_NoOp`; examples: `_SilentPromptDriver` in `test/installer/plugin_installer_pubspec_test.dart`, `_TestablePluginInstallCommand` (pins `getProjectRoot()` and `resolveInstallYaml()`) and `_RecordingBootstrapRunner` in `test/commands/plugin_install_command_test.dart`. Never expose them as shared test utilities: copy between files until a third caller appears, then extract.

## InMemoryFs or a real temp directory

Pick by what the production code touches, not by preference.

- `InMemoryFs` with `InstallContext.test(fs: InMemoryFs(), ...)` for file operations that go through `InstallContext.fs` (`stageForTest`, `pendingOps`). Code that hardcodes `RealFs()` cannot be tested this way.
- A real `Directory.systemTemp.createTempSync('<prefix>_')` project, with `InstallContext.test(fs: const RealFs(), ...)`, for operations that read or edit a consumer file through an editor (injections, pubspec edits) and for content assertions: seed fixtures, commit or read `pendingOps`, read the files back. Needed for `_registerDowelProvider` in `plugin_install_command.dart`.

## Seeding a consumer project

Start from `_seedConsumerProject` in `test/commands/plugin_install_command_test.dart` (pubspec, `.dart_tool/package_config`, optionally the `lib/app/_plugins.g.dart` barrel). `_seedLibApp` in `test/commands/plugins_refresh_command_test.dart` is copied per file for the `lib/app` existence check.

## Idempotency

Run the operation twice with separate installer instances, so the second run exercises the production replace-by-name path rather than a first-call cache, and assert one entry on disk: `hasLength(1)` on the entries read back from `plugins.json`, and `allMatches(...)` with `hasLength(1)` for the import and constructor lines in `_plugins.g.dart`.

## Failure paths

Each behavioural change gets a dedicated test for the edge it touches: empty list, dry-run guard, write failure, atomic-commit rollback, idempotent re-run. Force a rename failure by pre-creating the target as a directory (`.dowel/plugins.json` in `test/commands/plugin_install_command_test.dart`), which throws `FileSystemException` on POSIX.

## Coverage

Coverage counts lines, not branches: when a branch holds all the new behaviour, test both sides.
